author: Cal
text: Roots is a lovely little spot on Newland Ave. It’s colourful inside and has a relaxed beach bar feel to it. There’s loads of rum to choose from if you’re just popping in for a drink, and they do jerk ribs and Jamaican patties if you fancy something to eat.

author: Smiley Riley
text: Riz is amazing, great drinks and prices, lovely atmosphere too, outside space is lovely too with heaters.

author: Tom Garforth
text: Riz and Hamza served us excellently, great customer service and atmosphere

author: Etihadair Maude
text: excellent service, Riz, Hamza serve the best pints ever

author: Leona Gibbons
text: £14.99 for the best roast dinner you'll ever have in Hull. Staff are so lovely and helpful and nothings too much hassle.

author: Robin Alden
text: Good food and service.  It's a lively place. We didn't try cocktails this time, but maybe next time.

author: Donna
text:
Had Sunday carvery delivered, it was beautiful.  So tasty and filling.
Will definitely be ordering again.
